title: Repossession and Collateral Recovery Vehicle Intake and Notice of Intent to Sell
content:
**Rule.** When the vehicle comes into the company's possession under Repossession and Collateral Recovery, the contract becomes repossessed on the recovery date, a condition report is completed at the storage lot (a condition report with photos is required at intake in every class), and a notice of intent to sell is mailed by certified mail, return receipt requested, within 3 business days after the recovery date (Monday to Friday excluding federal holidays).

The notice of intent to sell states the borrower's right to redeem by paying the full payoff plus expenses, and that the borrower may be liable for a deficiency.

A notice returned undeliverable is re-mailed to any newer address on file and the earliest sale date restarts from the new mailing date.

When personal property was found in the vehicle a personal property notice is also mailed under the personal property rule of this program.

## Retired wording

Two phrases of the original rule are **no longer in force** and have been superseded by the current basis:

- "The notice of intent to sell states an earliest sale date exactly the class minimum notice period in calendar days after its mailing date" — no longer in force.
- "the reinstatement amount where reinstatement is available (otherwise 0.00)", as a statement the notice makes — no longer in force.

The rest of this rule — the repossessed date, the condition report, the mailing method and window, the statements of the right to redeem and of possible deficiency liability, the re-mailing of an undeliverable notice and the personal property notice — remains in force.

## Mailing window illustration (hypothetical, no federal holiday in the week)

| Recovery day | Business days counted after it | Last day to mail |
|---|---|---|
| Friday | Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday | Wednesday |
| Tuesday | Wednesday, Thursday, Friday | Friday |

A Saturday or Sunday is never counted, and a federal holiday falling Monday to Friday is skipped as well.

superseded_clauses: The notice of intent to sell states an earliest sale date (deadline_date) exactly noi_min_days_before_sale calendar days after its mailing date
the reinstatement amount where reinstatement is available (stated_amount_usd, otherwise 0.00)
